project_metadata.project_title: Project 25 — HR Talent Retention & Employee Exit Analytics Dashboard
project_metadata.program: IBM Q2D PEARL Global Talent Discovery & Development Program
project_metadata.benchmark_dataset: IBM HR Analytics Employee Attrition Dataset (1,470 records, 35 attributes)

metrics.primary_model: Random Forest Classifier (100 Estimators, Max Depth 8, Balanced Weights)

feature_importance.description: High overtime frequency significantly increases burnout risk (>3x attrition factor)
Lower income brackets (<$3,500/mo) correlate strongly with market flight
Early-career employees (<5 yrs experience) show higher voluntary mobility
Low job/environment satisfaction (Level 1-2) doubles exit probability
Long commute distances (>15 miles) drive fatigue and turnover
Poor work-life balance scores accelerate departure timeline
Single employees have 25.5% attrition vs 11.7% for married/divorced
Short manager tenure (<1.5 yrs) increases flight risk during transitions
